nhl.league_scoring_environment.measurement_fix: As of date t, n = number of team-games completed league-wide before t. nhl.scratch_void_risk.assessment: Measurement is a one-line sketch with no model, as-of vintage or definition of void vs zero settlement; no raw_data listed. Overlaps nhl.injuries_pit and m.rules_text, so keep only the settlement-conditional EV.
raw_data: historical scratch rates by player role
nhl.scratch_void_risk.measurement_fix: Parse the contract rules_primary into dnp_rule in {void, zero, loss} and record rule vintage. P(play) = 1 - P(scratch or injury absence) from nhl.injuries_pit status (out/GTD/probable) mapped to historical rates by status (shrunk k=30 cases) and, on game day, from confirmed lineups; use only vintages before decision time. EV under void = P(yes | play), under zero/loss = P(play) x P(yes | play) (leg counts as not occurring). Output P(play), both EVs and the rule vintage.

nhl.series_adjustment_regime.assessment: Playoff coach-level adjustment effects with k=20 games over four seasons are far below detectable size; the aggregate game 1-2 vs 5-7 goal change is confounded by series selection (surviving series are more even) and overlaps nhl.series_state_scoring_shift.
raw_data: playoff game goals by series and game index
